call_points.text: Morgan Heights is removed from launch numbers after SEIAA revoked its environmental clearance; homebuyers were refunded.
The 5-6% improvement in contribution margin is expected to be mostly retained through FY27, depending on mix.
FY27 pre-sales guided at least 20% growth over FY26, aiming for ₹9,000 Cr.
FY27 residential launch pipeline is 11.6 mn sq ft with GDV of ₹11,900 Cr.
Reported residential margins are low-teens/mid-teens, but operational POCM EBITDA runs near 30%.
Re-leasing of the vacated WTC space expected at 10–15% higher rents, up to 20% for half floors.
About 3 mn sq ft of commercial is expected to get OC in FY27; aim to at least double FY26 leasing.

entities.name: Brigade Estates and Projects Private Limited

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: FY26 average realisation rose 9% YoY to ₹12,107 per sq ft; FY27 launch APR is about ₹10,000 per sq ft as mix shifts to mid-segment.
Leasing income of ₹1,303 Cr split into ₹877 Cr office, ₹220 Cr retail and ₹206 Cr management business; GCCs are 58% of the leased portfolio.
Land bank is 57 mn sq ft, about 75% residential; unsold inventory is 7.5 mn sq ft.
Q1FY27 realisation was ₹14,256 per sq ft, up 21% YoY, on pricing increases and a shift to higher-value homes.
Commercial office portfolio was 8 msf at 88% occupancy; GCCs were 58% of Q1 gross leasing and IT/ITES 26% of the portfolio mix.
Unsold inventory value was ₹8,950 Cr across 6.7 msf, including 0.7 msf of Morgan Heights with ₹650 Cr attributable value.
Signed management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation for two Hyatt Regency hotels in Bengaluru totaling 600 rooms (350 rooms at Brigade Global Park, 250 rooms on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road).

timeline.summary: On its 7 May 2026 Q4FY26 call, Brigade guided FY27 pre-sales to at least ₹9,000 Cr after FY26 pre-sales fell 5% to ₹7,424 Cr on launch delays, with net debt of ₹2,278 Cr and debt/equity of 0.27.

On 14 August 2026 Brigade's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 presales guidance at ₹9,000 Cr, reported PAT of ₹217 Cr (up 37%) and said the Morgan Heights relaunch was stalled by a revoked environmental clearance.
Brigade Group signed management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation for two new Hyatt Regency hotels (600 rooms) in Bengaluru.
